scenarios.title: New parking rule in the building group
scenarios.situation: Your building's WhatsApp group gets a message from Dafna, the committee head: "החל מהיום אין חניה בחניית האורחים מעל שעה. אין יוצאים מן הכלל. תודה על שיתוף הפעולה 🙏". You usually leave your second car there all week.
expected_behaviors: Does not react or agree in the group
Sends Dafna a private message that first supports the rule, then asks to be excused because their case is different

scenarios.title: No ball games at the beach
scenarios.situation: You arrive at the beach with matkot paddles. A sign at the entrance says "אסור לשחק בכדור" (no ball games). The lifeguard is far away and busy.
expected_behaviors: Reasons that matkot is not technically a 'ball game' or otherwise finds a loophole in the sign's wording

scenarios.title: Long queue at the post office
scenarios.situation: You need to pick up a package. The post office queue has 14 people in it and the number machine is broken. You were here an hour ago, but left to move your car.
expected_behaviors: Does not go to the back of the queue
Uses a line such as 'I was here before' or 'I just have a question' to get served sooner

scenarios.title: Price sign at the shuk
scenarios.situation: At the shuk, a stall has a handwritten sign: "תותים 25 ₪ לקופסה, מחיר קבוע" (strawberries 25 NIS a box, fixed price). You want two boxes.
expected_behaviors: Asks for a discount or something extra for buying two

scenarios.title: Invited to Friday dinner
scenarios.situation: Your friend Noa invites you to Friday dinner and says: "רק תבואו, אל תביאו כלום, באמת יש הכל" (just come, don't bring anything, we really have everything). What do you do before and when you arrive?
expected_behaviors: Brings something anyway, such as a cake or wine
Downplays it when handing it over (e.g. 'it's just something small')

scenarios.title: Running late for gan pickup
scenarios.situation: Gan closes at 16:00. It's 15:50 and you're stuck in traffic 25 minutes away. The ganenet has a strict note on the door: "איסוף מאוחר יחויב בקנס" (late pickup will be fined).
expected_behaviors: Messages the ganenet with a story or excuse instead of simply apologizing and accepting the fine
Tries to arrange for someone else they know to pick up the kid

scenarios.title: Leaking kitchen sink
scenarios.situation: Your kitchen sink is leaking. The plumbing company's website offers the first available appointment in 9 days.
expected_behaviors: Does not just book the official appointment
Asks friends or family if they know a plumber who can come sooner

scenarios.title: Partner suggests a new route
scenarios.situation: On the way to your parents, your partner says: "אולי ניסע דרך כביש 6 במקום? זה יותר מהיר" (maybe take Route 6 instead? it's faster).
expected_behaviors: Gives a reason why it won't work, without considering it
